title: Wire validated cached SME feedback into streaming arms
description: As an evaluator, I need selected stream reviews to reveal validated cached SME labels and bounded explanations only after their prediction, so B/L/E/X compare the intended feedback channels. Scenario: a prediction is recorded before selected cached feedback is revealed; L receives only a label; E receives correct/wrong wording; X shuffles reason content from already reviewed donors while retaining the target trusted label. Rule-repeat budgets are per arm and seeded batch; one reveal is computed once so digest and record agree; ambiguous/missing records cannot invent labels or explanations; merged labels stay canonical; no full policy or future/scoreboard data reaches the analyst. Implement a pure feedback adapter and optional driver/arm injection, specs first with fakes, no paid calls. DoD: adjacent specs and actual fake-runtime integration, text-free audit, no DSPy, protected scoreboard, clean pinned clone.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented in a164287: cached SME provider injected into concrete stream arms. Driver appends prediction before reveal; arm also refuses reveal before prediction or outside pool. Trusted label_only records are retained; absent/invalid feedback remains unavailable. L hides reasons; E formats correct/disagree reasons; X draws only prior same-arm explanations with donor-rule quotas while retaining target gold. Prepared feedback consumed once; labels cannot be substituted; no static reason-hash fallback for missing/suppressed explanations. Focused pure+driver25 passed/4 optional skips; rich feedback/serving19 passed plus final pool/pre-prediction/mismatch integration rerun1 passed. Full verification running; no live collection.
